name: Morning Shapes
description: Sunny and toy-like: warm cream pages, flat saturated fields with arched edges, crescent-shaded geometric shapes, slowly breathing glyphs and chunky pills that sink onto a 2px ledge. Suits wellness, learning and habit apps.

provenance.notes: Derived design language; no name, logo mark, mascot characters or faces, copy, illustration, animation file or photography carried over. The proprietary grotesque is replaced with Figtree (fallback DM Sans) and its mono with DM Mono, all SIL OFL 1.1. Shapes, glyphs and vignettes are construction recipes for original artwork. Derived, not observed: dark appearance (from the night palette), form validation, toasts, dialogs, dashboards, tables, loading and error states. Adjusted for accessibility: text on tangerine is ink (white measured under 3:1), error red deepened, form-control borders raised to 3:1, secondary text set to a warm grey at 6.8:1.

fonts.fallback: DM Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
